description: Inference Endpoint Capturing Data Without a Customer Managed Key
rationale: Data capture writes the requests the endpoint receives and the responses it returns to S3, verbatim. Those are the inference payloads, so the destination accumulates whatever callers send the model - which for most models is the personal or business data the prediction is about - in plaintext JSON lines, continuously, with nobody looking at it. Encrypted with a key AWS manages, that store cannot be scoped to the roles that ought to read it, its decryption cannot be denied and access to it cannot be revoked by disabling a key, which is the one control that matters for a growing archive of production inputs.
remediation: Update the data capture configuration of the endpoint to name a customer managed KMS key, scope its key policy to the roles that analyse the captured data, and set a lifecycle policy on the destination prefix so the archive does not grow without end
